sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Baroque Pearl Tulip Toggle Clasp Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Embrace a sweet, minimalist look with this baroque imitation pearl bracelet. Featuring a unique tulip-themed OT toggle clasp, this elegant piece is designed for girls and teenagers who love a touch of vintage charm. Perfect for daily wear, it makes a lovely and versatile gift for any occasion
